deployments_detail.use: Own 70B-parameter Japanese/multimodal LLMs (on Gemma/Qwen bases) for on-prem enterprise; document-understanding AI

RICOH Intelligent Automation, an AI-powered SaaS platform for intelligent document processing (OCR, handwritten text recognition, data extraction from unstructured documents in 200+ languages) with planned generative AI assistant functionality; piloting in selected markets ahead of phased global rollout. [natif.ai (OCR/image recognition, Ricoh subsidiary)]

Scalable intelligent document processing solution for healthcare document automation (insurance claims, appeals, grievances, clinical records) using generative AI for classification and extraction with human-in-the-loop review; in production. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Textract, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS)]
deployments_detail.value: Processes 10,000+ healthcare documents/month (scalable to 70,000); onboarding cut from 4-6 weeks to 2-3 days (>90%); 98-99% accuracy; manual review costs reduced 60-70%

deployments_detail.use: Multimodal LLM (LMM) built on Alibaba's Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct under Japan's GENIAC program, trained on ~600,000 business-document images to read Japanese corporate documents containing diagrams, pie charts, bar graphs and flowcharts; offered to customers and bundled in the RICOH On-Premise LLM Starter Kit. [Alibaba Qwen2.5-VL (base model); GENIAC (METI/NEDO)]

Integration of natif.ai Intelligent Document Processing (AI-based OCR/image recognition) into DocuWare document management to improve extraction from handwritten documents such as purchase orders and auto-sort documents by content; widely used in Germany and being adapted for Japanese-language processing. [natif.ai; DocuWare (both Ricoh companies)]

Ricoh's own 70-billion-parameter LLM supporting Japanese, English and Chinese with high Japanese performance, offered in cloud-based and secure on-premise configurations; expansion of an AI-solutions partnership with AWS Japan to bring it to market. [AWS Japan (partnership)]

13-billion-parameter bilingual (Japanese/English) Llama-2-based LLM trained with curriculum learning on AWS Trainium, developed under the AWS LLM Development Support Program; pre-trained on a Japanese corpus and evaluated on llm-jp-eval benchmarks. [AWS Trainium (64 trn1.32xlarge / 1,024 Trainium chips); Meta Llama 2]
deployments_detail.value: 50% reduction in training cost and 25% decrease in training time (per AWS Trainium/Inferentia customer series)

deployments_detail.use: RICOH Digital Buddy for Local Governments, a generative-AI service that auto-generates responses to citizen inquiries from registered regulatory/internal documents and summarizes long plans and reports; runs inside the LGWAN secure network with no use of input data for training. Launched in Standard and Advanced editions. [Ricoh Japan]

Ricoh GPT, an in-house GPT-3-class Japanese LLM developed on AWS; used for natural-language vector search of technical databases for equipment malfunction causes, a custom GPT giving maintenance workers technical info via voice queries, and interactive 'digital human' avatars for customer engagement. [AWS (Amazon SageMaker, EC2 P4d, S3, FSx for Lustre, ML Solutions Lab)]

RICOH Intelligent Support uses AI and big data on internet-connected multifunction printers (MFPs) for predictive/preventive maintenance: analyzing usage and environment to detect anomalies, predict part failures, trigger firmware updates and auto-notify call centers before breakdowns occur. [Ricoh (@Remote platform)]
